name: Winston S. Churchill
roles: British MP and minister across multiple governments

life_arc.events: Aristocratic family; Sandhurst; army service, war reporting and early political career.
Rose through Liberal and later wartime offices; developed reputation for activism and independent judgment.
Gallipoli crisis and political damage; returned to major office; shaped interwar policy.
Opposed appeasement and warned about German rearmament; remained isolated until crisis.
Led coalition government; sustained resistance; built Anglo-American and Anglo-Soviet coalition.
Opposition after 1945; Iron Curtain speech; returned as prime minister.
Retired as prime minister; remained influential writer and statesman until death.

failure_modes: willingness to incur very high short-term costs
